body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Rounds 1-3: 5 Cursor specialists in parallel + generic Codex. Main agent reviewed findings across up to 3 rounds.

Round 1: accepted=2, rejected=0. Findings: (1) jq -Rs missing -c flag (correctness, Codex), (2) printf leading-dash option risk in test (code-quality, Codex). Both folded inline.

Early stop: round 1 classified non-substantial (accepted=2, no high-severity bugs, < ~100 LOC fixes).
